name: Koshino Takashi
source: Takashi is Takumi's best friend and Karen's older brother, and he acts like an older brother to Takumi too. His family owns one of the stores in town, and he assists with deliveries. He had tried to confess his love to many girls in the past, but ended up giving up in the middle of doing so.
